rules.meaning: After a whitespace-prefixed double hyphen, typing trailing whitespace replaces the two hyphens and trailing trigger with em dash plus captured same trailing whitespace; preceding context remains.

After an isolated one-letter Cyrillic word plus literal ASCII space, typing the next word first Cyrillic letter replaces that space with NBSP and retains the letter. Includes Ё/ё explicitly and supports consecutive one-letter words.

omissions: No runtime configuration/disabled rule subset/locale argument; typingTypography() always installs the four fixed rules. No English curly-quote preset is specified.
No ordinary-link/reference-link exclusion or link fixture. AC48.2 needs an explicit policy; do not pretend the baseline already protects links.
No normal CmdZ/redo, complete canonical bytes, exact final directed selection, identity, stamp or publication count goldens. Immediate Backspace undoInputRule differs from normal history.
No genuine OS composition/dead-key or trusted terminal proof. The single composition fixture is an untrusted end-only event on an already changed document.
No paste/drop/import/export transformation tests in this source pair; the introductory paste.ts comment is context, not authority to change OSR47 literal paste policy.
No cross-block/foreign tree/partial structural range or full rich boundary corpus; hard break and one inline-code selection are covered narrowly.
No exact whitespace-class portability cases; freeze the ECMAScript source class rather than assume a Rust predicate is equivalent.
No Ё/ё-positive, all opening-prefix characters, mark-split EGC/nonBMP/decomposed, Unicode whitespace, native maps, high-water or bounded-work goldens.
No no-full-export assertion; new48 must measure its actual implementation without inheriting old CMS typing architecture.
